name: Lionbridge Translation Provider
description: TMGMT translator plugin that connects Drupal to the Lionbridge Content API for professional (human) translation, with auto-bundling and continuous-job features.
version_note: Documented from installed on-disk source (release 9.5.0); not test-enabled this wave because its tmgmt dependency could not be installed. No live/drush verification was performed against the running site.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 The Lionbridge Connector for Drupal TMGMT is an external translation service for the Translation Management Tool module. It allows users to send content directly from Drupal sites to the Lionbridge Translation Services for professional translation.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 No technical issues – Our technical support team will engage with your technical team and ensure project success. 
 Support from your global teams – Ensure your brand voice is effectively applied across all content you translate. We work closely with your teams across all languages and geographies to develop linguistic assets that embody your brand voice and ensure consistent application across all content types and sources. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This modules requires TMGMT as well as a username, a password, and an API access token from a Lionbridge Translation Services account. Please contact us for additional details.

 Back to top 

 Credentials to Lionbridge Services 
 If you still don't have a set of credentials for the latest Lionbridge Translation Services, or if you are having troubles remembering your legacy Translation Services credentials, please send email to Lionbridge support
